quality_assessment: Excellent chapter with accurate information, comprehensive examples, and well-structured content
positive_aspects: Accurately states ripgrep does NOT auto-discover config files (unlike features.json which has incorrect info)
Clear explanation of RIPGREP_CONFIG_PATH environment variable setup
Comprehensive configuration file format documentation with both rules clearly stated
Excellent examples showing both flag=value and multi-line formats
Accurate explanation of flag precedence (config prepended, CLI overrides)
Documents --debug flag for troubleshooting config file loading
Comprehensive error handling documentation (file read errors, parse errors, platform differences)
Rich set of common configuration patterns with practical examples
Good use cases and best practices section
References FAQ and GUIDE.md for additional context
